messages:
Leah S.: quick heads-up — after last night's roles/permissions schema deploy we're seeing a small but consistent uptick in 403s for a subset of API calls (about 2.8%). routing to eng-security for visibility
Samir K.: which service is throwing the denies? policy-evaluator?
Leah S.: yes, policy-evaluator v2.1.1. stacktrace points to policy check path where `role_id` is nullable now; earlier code assumed non-null default. looks like new migration left some rows NULL instead of assigning a default role.
Irene: oh — that's the change where we made `role_id` nullable to support external principals. missed a backfill step?
Mike T.: can we confirm it's not KMS/crypto-related? those 403s are authz not authn. logs show `decision=DENY reason=NO_ROLE`
Leah S.: confirmed. sample log: `service=policy-evaluator request_id=abc123 decision=DENY details="principal_role=null"`
policy-bot: @channel incident-note created: INC-2026-0452 — unexplained 403 spike, suspect rolebackfill omission. tagged eng-security, eng-platform
Samir K.: immediate mitigation — we can short-circuit the evaluator to treat NULL as the low-privilege default (viewer) until we backfill. That buys time but we must be careful about semantics.
Irene: agree. short-term config toggle OK, but we need a fix plan with timeline. Also need audit entries for any accesses allowed by the toggle.
Rosa (oncall): I've started a canary: toggled `policy.null_role_fallback=viewer` in prod on 2% of traffic (shard-us-east-1). monitoring dashboards on slack-alerts.
Leah S.: thanks Rosa. can we also get a safe backfill job? prefer a safe-rate limited DB update that sets `role_id = <viewer_role_uuid>` where NULL, and an eventual checksum to verify counts.
Samir K.: proposed SQL (dry-run first):
```sql
BEGIN;
-- dry-run: count rows that would be affected
SELECT count(*) FROM principals WHERE role_id IS NULL;
-- backfill in batches of 10k
UPDATE principals
SET role_id = '0000-0000-viewer-uuid'
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT id FROM principals WHERE role_id IS NULL LIMIT 10000
);
COMMIT;
```
Irene: add an `updated_by='rbac-backfill-2026-03'` metadata column update so audit logs can correlate. Also flag rows with `prebackfill_role_null=true` for rollback tracing.
Mike T.: who will run the job? eng-platform or eng-security? prefer eng-platform-runbook + a short handoff.
Leah S.: eng-platform to run, eng-security to review. Samir, can you write the runbook snippet and include the pre-count, checksum and rollback SQL?
Samir K.: on it. will include pause points after first 50k and a canary sweep. plan: dry-run -> canary 5k -> pause -> 50k -> pause -> full (rate-limited). estimate 3 hours total if no surprises.
Leah S.: also need to surface this to compliance: any change that maps nullable principals to an access role needs audit entries. @Irene can you open a ticket and attach sample logs and the backfill plan?
Irene: done — COMP-1783 opened and linked to INC-2026-0452. attaching logs and proposed SQL.
policy-bot: deploy-bot reports: policy-evaluator rollback toggle applied (config ID cfg-778) to canary shard.
Rosa (oncall): canary looks good so far, 1.8% 403 -> 0.3% in shard. CPU unaffected.
Leah S.: good. one more ask: can we add a short-lived audit query that captures any granted accesses that would have been denied pre-backfill? we should store decisions so compliance can sample them.
Mike T.: yes — policy-evaluator can emit `decision=FALLBACK_ROLE_GRANTED` for a week with a unique tag. we'll persist to audit_events table.
Samir K.: I'll add that tag and ensure we rotate the key used for signing audit events (KMS key id: projects/redwood/keys/audit-v2) — will coordinate with ops.
Irene: timeline check: eng-platform runbook ready in ~45min, backfill starts after approval, we aim to finish today and then remove the short-circuit in 24h if audits look good.
Leah S.: thanks everyone. will post post-mortem with root cause (migration omitted backfill) and action items: 1) add migration preflight checklist, 2) test that nullable schema paths have explicit fallback in policy code, 3) auto-run a pre-deploy audit that runs the `SELECT count(*) FROM principals WHERE role_id IS NULL`.
Rosa (oncall): keeping watch — I'll escalate if canary regresses. :thumbsup:
